# HireGo AI

HireGo AI is a hiring technology and managed hiring company based in Noida, India.

Official website: https://www.hiregoai.com/
About: https://www.hiregoai.com/about
Services: https://www.hiregoai.com/services
Managed Hiring / Pay Per Hire: https://www.hiregoai.com/pay-per-hire
Hire Talent in India: https://www.hiregoai.com/hire-talent-in-india
Employer Co-Pilot: https://www.hiregoai.com/ai-hiring-copilot
Candidate Screening: https://www.hiregoai.com/candidate-screening-software
AI Mock Interview: https://www.hiregoai.com/ai-mock-interview
Jobs: https://www.hiregoai.com/jobs
Pricing: https://www.hiregoai.com/pricing
Contact: https://www.hiregoai.com/contact

HireGo AI supports connected hiring workflows including candidate sourcing, structured screening, assessments, interview coordination and joining follow-up. Employers remain responsible for consequential hiring decisions.
